body.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, and ensure_ascii=false.
body.hash_rule: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical unsigned transition object
body.signature_rule: Ed25519 signature over the UTF-8 bytes of the lowercase canonical hash; signature is unprefixed base64.
body.key_resolution: Resolve the binding_key_id from the linked supported permit.decision.v1 evidence against a permit_binding_signing trust root active at decision_at.

linkage_rules.identity: permit_id and project_id MUST equal the linked issuance-time Permit decision and evidence-pack identity.
linkage_rules.source: from_decision MUST equal the signed issuance-time decision.
linkage_rules.target: to_decision and to_status MUST equal the evidence pack's recorded decision state.
linkage_rules.approval: permit.challenge_approved MUST transition challenge/awaiting_attestation to allow/attested.

claim_boundary.establishes: The issuing key recorded the linked review transition and actor identifier.
does_not_establish: the natural-person identity or organizational role behind actor_id
